items.name: Friend of Cotswold's Ring
items.lore: Copper, with a sheaf on it. Every Warden has one; now so do you.

items.name: Hedge-Warden's Belt
items.lore: A Warden's belt, with a hook for the billhook and a pouch for the tally.

items.name: Right Hand's Torc
items.lore: Bronze, twisted like a hay-rope. Hollis's own design.

items.name: Cotswold Fold Bracer
items.lore: Sheepskin and iron. Warm, and it stops a wolf's teeth.

items.name: Mantle of the Hearthward
items.lore: Cotswold green, with the village hearth stitched in gold. Only the Hearthwards wear it.

items.name: Watch-Friend's Ring
items.lore: Iron, stamped with Prydwen - Arthur's ship.

items.name: Watch-Road Belt
items.lore: The Watch rides every road to Camelot. This belt has done most of them.

items.name: Sworn Torc of the Watch
items.lore: Silver and blue. Given when a Watch-Friend swears the oath.

items.name: Round Table Bracer
items.lore: Chased with a ring of twelve seats - and a thirteenth, empty.

items.name: Mantle of the Shield of Camelot
items.lore: Pendragon red, with the dragon in gold. Only the Shields of Camelot wear it.
